tools.description:
Can I use this feature, and from which browser version?

Accepts a loose name (":has()", "container queries", "css-grid") and resolves it to a caniuse feature, then returns the earliest continuously-supported version per major browser, global usage percentage, and a conservative safe_to_use flag. Use this first; it answers the whole question in one call.

feature.description: Feature name or caniuse id. Loose names are resolved, e.g. "has selector" finds "css-has".

tools.name: check_feature_support

global_support_percent.description: Percentage of tracked global users on a browser version that fully supports it.

meaning.description: One sentence, safe to show a user verbatim.

other_matches.description: Other features the query could have meant.

resolved_from.description: The query that was matched, so a caller can see what it actually asked about.

safe_to_use.description: True only when global support is at least 90% AND no major browser is missing it. A conservative single answer.

current.description: State in the newest release: supported, partial support, not supported, supported behind a vendor prefix, disabled by default.

latest_version.description: Newest released version caniuse tracks for this browser.

since.description: Earliest version from which support has held continuously to the newest release. Null when never supported.

supported_now.description: Whether the newest released version supports it.

support.description: Per-browser detail, keyed by caniuse browser id.

unsupported_in.description: Major browsers whose newest release still does not support it.

tools.title: Check Feature Support
